summary:
[Goal]
"In every file under policy/, replace '90 days' with '30 days' and keep the rest of the text as it is."

[Constraints]
- If a write is refused on a read-only file, stop trying on that file, leave it exactly as it is, and instead write policy/pending-changes.md naming the file that still needs a manual update.

[Done]

- Attempted to update policy/security.md but the write was refused (EACCES: read-only file).

[State]
- policy/access.md and policy/backup.md are updated.
- policy/security.md remains unchanged (read-only).
- policy/pending-changes.md has not been created yet.

[Key values]
- policy/access.md
- policy/backup.md
- policy/security.md
- policy/pending-changes.md
- EACCES: read-only file: policy/security.md

[Decisions]
- Stopped further write attempts on policy/security.md per the user's instruction for read-only files.

[Issues]
- policy/security.md still contains "90 days" and requires a manual update.

[Next]
- Create policy/pending-changes.md naming policy/security.md as the file that still needs a manual update.
